author: Cinna Davis
statement: For any graph-only packet assignment, a canonical Boolean unary network has opposite-parity collision with zero data through precision K(a+1-i) at every retained node of valuation i<u and jet order below K, where K >= ceil(M/2^u).
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size proof
Realize or rule out generic tapered MD_i/u precision for the actual Boolean tensor interface
Assess whether tensor-aware recovery can exploit structure of arbitrary inputs
